// port: The port of the gateway: point an Ollama client (ollamaUrl of the server, of the agents) to http://localhost:11435.
// upstream: Ollama, where every request goes in the end.
// dataDirectory: The cache, the settings and the rules changed at run time (~ is the home folder).

cache.// embeddingModel: An embedding model of Ollama (ollama pull nomic-embed-text); when it is missing, a local embedding of the words is used.
cache.// threshold: The cosine similarity of the prompts from which a cached answer is given back (with the embedding model).
cache.// lexicalThreshold: The same with the local embedding of the words (closer to the words, so stricter).
cache.// entityGuard: A cached answer is given back only when the prompts hold the same numbers, dates, amounts, URLs, names…
cache.// minAnswers: The answers of the model kept for a prompt before the cache answers it, with one of them drawn at random, so that its answers vary (1: the first answer is given back each time).

routing.// overrideRequested: true: a rule that matches replaces the model asked by the client; false: only the model auto is routed.
routing.// defaultModel: The model of a request for auto when no rule matches.

rules.name: images
rules.description: A picture in the request: the model that sees.

rules.name: code
rules.description: Code, a stack trace, a language of programming: the reasoning model.

rules.name: math
rules.description: Formulas and calculations: the reasoning model.

rules.name: french-people-and-places
rules.description: A question in French about people, organisations or places: the multilingual model (off by default).

// gazetteers: Lists of names recognised as entities of the type given (any type, used by the rules as the others).
